title: Affine and empty-open cases of perfect-complex descent
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, (R_i) a directed system of Noetherian rings, c a colimit cocone, i an index, and s:X_i → Spec R_i a finitely presented morphism. Let U be an affine open of X_i or the empty open. Then P(U) holds, where P is [def-pc-perfect-descent-on-open]. In particular the descended object and comparison map are precisely the base changes specified by that predicate.

source.place: Tag 09RF, proof: affine case using Tags 08EB and 0BC7; empty base case of compact-open induction

proof.text: Treat the empty open as affine using isAffineOpen_bot. For each open-immersion presentation, affine image implies that the source is affine. Form the canonical tail ring diagram. Represent the limit perfect object by a bounded finite-projective complex over its colimit.

The tail is nonempty, containing i, and directed by common upper bounds. Apply exists_finite_projective_model_of_directed_colimit to obtain j and Pj with its boundedness, finiteness, projectivity and scalar-extension isomorphism.

Sheafify Pj using the explicit stage realization; it is perfect and its pullback is the limit realization of its scalar extension. Apply the limit realization functor to the algebraic complex isomorphism and compose this with the model isomorphism to E. The tail index yields j≥i and its map is definitionally the one in PerfectDescentOnOpen.

proof_origin.place: Affine case, implemented with canonical tail coordinate-ring diagram, algebraic complex descent and affine K-flat chart comparison; bottom open uses isAffineOpen_bot.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_descent_affine_open
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [∀ i : I, IsNoetherianRing (R.obj i)]
    (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c) (i : I) (Xi : Scheme.{u}) (s : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (U : Xi.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U ∨ U = ⊥) :
    PerfectDescentOnOpen R c i Xi s U
